title: Byte-verified credential-free capable-endpoint capability ladder (corrected freeze) and hosted-provisioning census under the frozen minimal multi-step Web-agent protocol, with a conditional external-comparator readiness/reproducibility table (readiness condition / blocker B3 for the gated four-arm benchmark).
question: After each candidate GGUF is re-pinned to the byte-level sha256 of the ACTUALLY SERVED BODY (verified by a full DESIGN-time download, NOT HF etag/xetHash tree-API metadata) and re-frozen with a revision-pinned URL, does either M-14B-QWEN (Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct Q4_K_M) or M-8B-LLAMA (Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct Q4_K_M) clear the frozen minimal multi-step Web-agent bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5 frozen seeded episodes) - and if not, what is the exact credential/operational blocker that must be removed to run a same-model/tools/budget hosted capability test; additionally recording, non-gating, whether any competitor-strength external comparator (QCR, compile-and-execute, site-memory/ColorBrowserAgent) is reproducible under this protocol. This is the corrected continuation of EXP-INTEL-38175568787 (MEASUREMENT_INVALID, substrate/provisioning failure, NOT a capability result): the frozen ladder was never executed because both candidates failed frozen step 3a - the pinned sha256 equaled the HF tree-API xetHash / CDN etag while the served body bytes (stable across three independent routes) hash to the tree-API lfs.oid at equal byte count.
hypothesis: H1 (capability). At least one predeclared credential-free candidate class not previously tested - M-14B-QWEN (scale beyond the tested 3B-8B Qwen ceiling) or M-8B-LLAMA (non-Qwen family at the failed 7B size band) - clears the inherited bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5 frozen seeded episodes) under the frozen minimal protocol and the frozen goal/schema system prompt, thereby satisfying readiness condition (3) at mechanism level with a factory-provisionable credential-free local endpoint. H2 (provisioning). No hosted same-protocol model endpoint is provisionable in this factory without a human-issued credential: every predeclared hosted provider is credential-gated (exact missing environment variable recorded) or unreachable, and the only reachable credential-free hosted path (Pollinations gpt-oss-20b) is operationally capped (reasoning-only content, small completion-token cap, intermittent HTTP 402, no model pinning/SLA). H3 (freeze-process repair, operational not scientific). The prior MEASUREMENT_INVALID was a freeze-process defect, not model behaviour: at DESIGN time the served-body sha256 of both candidates was obtained by full download and equals the tree-API lfs.oid, and the previously pinned xetHash/etag differs from it; re-pinning to the served body and adding a full-download byte-verification step makes the frozen content identity satisfiable against authentic served content.
falsifier: H0 (bounded negative). No predeclared credential-free candidate clears the bar - every COMPLETE candidate cell has task_success_rate < 0.6 - AND the census finds no PROVISIONABLE_CREDENTIATED hosted provider, so no currently-provisionable same-protocol endpoint (credential-free local or hosted) can drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent test and readiness condition (3) is NOT_SATISFIED; the gated four-arm benchmark must be re-scoped (drop the same-model external published-baseline anchor in favour of internally re-run comparators on a dynamic-range task bank, or obtain a hosted credential, or pursue a different model class). FALSIFIES is asserted only over the COMPLETE, predeclared credential-free local candidate set (a capability bound on those tested classes/quantisation, not a global rejection of C-LLM-INHERIT and not a closure of hosted frontier classes, which remain UNRESOLVED-by-blocker). A candidate whose GGUF fails the byte-level content-identity verification or whose treatment PC gate fails is recorded as UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED / UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED and is NOT counted as a capability failure; if no candidate is COMPLETE the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not a scientific negative.

baselines.description: Protocol-hardness anchor, NOT re-run. Under the byte-identical frozen minimal protocol and the goal/schema prompt (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, string sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716), both credential-free Qwen2.5 3B-8B Q4_K_M candidates failed the bar: M-7B-QWEN task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), zero answer actions; M-3B-QWEN task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5). Establishes that the frozen protocol is hard for the tested class (the bar is not trivially met) while constrained decoding is live.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL (carried reference; not re-run). Used only to certify protocol hardness and decoding liveness; it is not a comparator arm for the new candidates.

baselines.description: Uniform random action selection from the frozen 5-action space (click #reveal-btn; answer TARGET-41; answer TARGET-42; answer TARGET-43; answer unknown), 5 episodes, seeded random.Random(42) created once and reused (as the frozen runner's make_random_producer does), run against the SERVED task page through the same frozen run_episode scorer as the candidates. The parent's null-random mode ran on about:blank (a navigation defect); this design runs every mechanical control against the served page.
baselines.expected_outcome: parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (valid JSON by construction) and task_success_rate<0.6. Analytic per-episode success probability = sum_{j=1..4}(1/5)^(j+1) = 0.04992, so P(task_success_rate>=3/5)=P(Binomial(5,0.04992)>=3)~1.15e-3 and the 0.6 bar is effectively unreachable by chance. task_success_rate>=0.6 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.description: Credential-free hosted path, NOT re-run. Pollinations anonymous proxy (https://text.pollinations.ai/openai; GET /models resolves openai-fast -> gpt-oss-20b, tier anonymous, reasoning=true, tools=true). Under the same minimal Web-agent task the grandparent recorded: empty content with reasoning-only output and a ~197 completion-token cap despite max_tokens=1200, 1 step, 197 tokens; intermittent HTTP 402; no model pinning/SLA. Recorded in the census as CREDENTIAL_FREE_OPERATIONALLY_CAPPED with the exact operational blocker.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL (carried reference; not re-run). Establishes the exact operational blocker for the only reachable credential-free hosted path.

positive_control.success_criterion: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 per evaluated candidate cell; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight

members.protocol: 10 probes per evaluated candidate of the frozen probe string emitted by the frozen base config prompts.positive_control_probe ('Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}') under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA with the frozen GBNF grammar (string sha256 16c9877c0829b2099bd7180c212f28d8c545b095e9a4411afa7cabccd3fa6a65). Executed by the frozen runner mode_probe_candidate.
members.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema (positive_control_pass_rate=1.0)
members.failure_policy: a candidate whose PC gate fails is EXCLUDED (no episodes) and recorded UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED; it is not a capability failure.

members.protocol: 5 scripted episodes (click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42) driven through the REAL frozen run_episode scorer against the served page, with navigation repaired (page.goto before any episode). The scripted step producer returns json.dumps strings as required by the frozen parse_action contract.
members.success_criterion: 5/5 task_success=true (proves the scorer registers the full completion path and mechanical verification is live)
members.failure_policy: <5/5 -> preflight failure -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (scorer broken, not model behaviour).

null_control.protocol: 5 episodes of fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') through the real frozen scorer against the SERVED task page (navigated).
null_control.failure_policy: any parseable or successful episode -> verification logic broken -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID

measurement_validity: Corrected content-identity policy (the repair this experiment exists to make): each candidate is pinned to (i) sha256 of the FULLY DOWNLOADED served body, obtained at DESIGN time and equal to the HF tree-API lfs.oid, (ii) exact byte count, (iii) a repo-revision-pinned URL, and (iv) an independent GGUF metadata fingerprint (gguf_version, tensor_count, general.architecture, general.file_type, block_count, embedding_length, context_length, tokenizer.chat_template presence). The HF xetHash / CDN etag value is explicitly recorded as NOT a pin source. Full-download verification at DESIGN supersedes the parent's metadata-derived pin (see raw/design probe in prereg.md#appendix-b and spec.candidates[].digest_sources).

Frozen protocol identity: this packet reuses the audited frozen runner research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py (file sha256 2b5d5bb5da608adbcc68cc78120a88bc2b8809816e29f9d87d25c0c75bc25c00) and the frozen base fixture research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/harness_config.json (file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb). Both are freeze_artifacts; EXECUTE must re-verify their hashes and fail closed on mismatch.

Substrate identity: the task is the frozen single-page MIN-WEBAGENT-CLICK-REVEAL-ANSWER fixture (#reveal-btn reveals #target=TARGET-42; the reveal button is hidden after the first click), max_steps_per_episode=5, threshold_target_text=TARGET-42; served on 127.0.0.1 via the frozen start_page_server, driven by Playwright + /usr/bin/google-chrome.

Single manipulated dimension across candidates: only the model GGUF (and the model-family chat_format required to load it) differs between candidate cells. The task page, user template, system prompt (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, string sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716), GBNF grammar (string sha256 16c9877c0829b2099bd7180c212f28d8c545b095e9a4411afa7cabccd3fa6a65), sampling (temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, n_ctx=2048, llama_seed=42, base_seed=42, episode seeds 42-46, n_threads=4), strict parse_action and the mechanical run_episode scorer are identical for every candidate.

Per-candidate config overlays are deterministic transformations of the frozen base config: load the base config bytes and replace ONLY prompts.system (with the frozen P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA string), sampling.chat_format (with the candidate's family chat format) and candidate_models_frozen (with the single candidate's frozen entry). Every other key is inherited byte-for-byte. The overlay is written to the exact path the frozen runner reads: <per-candidate-outdir>/raw/harness_config.json. EXECUTE records each overlay's sha256 in provenance.json and verifies the object-level diff is confined to those three keys.

Strict mechanical verification: Playwright DOM assertions plus whole-string JSON-schema parse identical to the frozen parse_action (the entire completion must be valid JSON matching {action: click|answer, selector?: string, text?: string} with the action-appropriate required field); task_success additionally requires the mechanical reveal (#target visible with text TARGET-42) AND a terminal answer action whose text equals TARGET-42. No LLM grading.

Byte-level content identity is fail-closed and non-substituting: at frozen ladder step 3a EXECUTE streams the revision-pinned URL to a temp file, computes byte count + sha256, and parses the GGUF header fingerprint. IDENTITY-PASS requires bytes==pin AND sha256==pin AND fingerprint==pin. On sha256 mismatch the candidate is UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED (operational, not a capability failure); EXECUTE never substitutes a differing body, and records the observed body sha256, byte count and fingerprint as diagnostics. One re-download is permitted to distinguish transient transport corruption from a stable served-body drift; both attempts are logged.
The P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA prompt leaks neither '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42' (design-time verified), so a treatment success cannot be attributed to answer leakage.

Deterministic protocol: temperature=0.0 + fixed seeds. Under the frozen adequacy rule (5 episodes, 3/5 = 0.6 exactly) there is no variance estimate; 0.6 is a pre-declared capability-gate adequacy rule, not a statistical threshold. This limitation is inherited and disclosed.

Representation loss (inherited): state is a simplified text observation (PAGE_TEXT 300 chars, ELEMENTS over button/a/input, HISTORY), not a full accessibility tree. After the reveal, PAGE_TEXT contains TARGET-42 and ELEMENTS lists the (now hidden) reveal button; the tested class re-clicks it rather than answering. This packet changes only the model class, not the observation representation.

The endpoint census is observational (env-var presence + unauthenticated HTTP status/reachability + carried receipts). It is not outcome-bearing and is non-gating for the capability OUTCOME; it exists to answer the mandate's 'exact credential/operational blocker' clause. Hosted model numbers are CANDIDATE_NOT_EVIDENCE.

The external-comparator readiness/reproducibility table is a literature-identity enumeration (pinned arXiv IDs/titles/dates, reported metric, denominator, reproduction prerequisites, and a mechanical reproducibility-feasibility classification against this factory's obtainable substrate), explicitly labelled CANDIDATE_NOT_EVIDENCE and non-gating. No external vendor number is used as SPIDER evidence.

Scope bound: FALSIFIES is bounded to the predeclared credential-free local Q4_K_M classes tested (Qwen2.5-14B, Llama-3.1-8B) plus the carried Qwen 3B-8B anchors and the recorded non-provisionable hosted census. It does not close hosted frontier classes (blocked, not tested), other quantisations, other tasks, or other domains, and it does not globally reject C-LLM-INHERIT.
decision_rule: OUTCOME is exactly one of {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}. B3_STATUS is a separate derived field in {SATISFIED, NOT_SATISFIED, UNRESOLVED}. DEFINITIONS: a CELL(c) is one predeclared candidate c measured by the frozen runner research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py (mode probe-candidate) with its per-candidate config overlay = a PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING gate (10 probes) followed by an episode batch (clearing_threshold.episodes=5). CELL(c) is COMPLETE iff load_status==LOADED AND positive_control_pass_rate==1.0 AND exactly 5 episode records; EXCLUDED iff LOADED and the PC gate did not pass (no episodes); UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED iff the byte-level content-identity verification at 3a failed or the model failed to load; PARTIAL iff the PC gate passed but fewer than 5 episode records. CLEARS(c) iff COMPLETE and task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6. PRECEDENCE (first matching rule wins): (1) PREFLIGHT, executed once before the ladder: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE==5/5 AND NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION==(parseable 0.0, task_success 0.0) AND B-RANDOM-ACTION==(parseable 1.0, task_success_rate<0.6) AND all freeze_artifact hash checks match AND required stack imports succeed; else OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED, STOP. (2) ENDPOINT CENSUS, executed independently and non-gating: for each predeclared provider record credential_env, credential_present, unauthenticated reachability_http_status, classification in {PROVISIONABLE_CREDENTIATED, CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED, CREDENTIAL_FREE_OPERATIONALLY_CAPPED, UNREACHABLE} and blocker (exact missing env var / HTTP status / operational cap). (3) CAPABILITY LADDER over [M-14B-QWEN, M-8B-LLAMA] in order; for each candidate c: (3a) BYTE-LEVEL CONTENT-IDENTITY VERIFICATION - stream the revision-pinned URL to a temp path with no size cap, compute byte count and sha256, and parse the GGUF header fingerprint; IDENTITY-PASS iff bytes==pinned bytes AND sha256==pinned served_body_sha256 AND fingerprint==pinned fingerprint; on any mismatch allow ONE re-download, and if it still mismatches record observed bytes/sha256/fingerprint and mark UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED, continue (never substitute a differing body); (3b) load (failure -> UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED, continue); (3c) run the PC gate then the 5 episodes; if EXCLUDED -> UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED, continue; if PARTIAL -> record and continue; (3d) if COMPLETE and CLEARS -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS, B3_STATUS=SATISFIED, STOP (early stop on the first clearing candidate); (3e) if COMPLETE and does not CLEAR -> record TREATMENT_FAILS_BAR, continue. (4) AFTER THE LADDER (no candidate cleared): let measured = { c in ladder : CELL(c) COMPLETE and not CLEARS }; if measured is empty -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED, STOP; else OUTCOME=FALSIFIES and B3_STATUS = NOT_SATISFIED iff every predeclared hosted provider is CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED / UNREACHABLE / CREDENTIAL_FREE_OPERATIONALLY_CAPPED, else UNRESOLVED (a credentialed hosted provider is provisionable, so a hosted capability test remains the smallest next action). A candidate identity/load failure or PC failure is never encoded as a capability failure. Canonical packet mapping: SUPPORTS -> result.outcome=SUPPORTS, result.status=COMPLETE; FALSIFIES -> result.outcome=FALSIFIES, result.status=COMPLETE; MEASUREMENT_INVALID -> result.status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, result.outcome=INCONCLUSIVE. B3_STATUS, the census records and the external-comparator table are written in result.metrics/observations and do not override the frozen OUTCOME.
product_consequence_positive: If a predeclared credential-free candidate CLEARS the bar (OUTCOME=SUPPORTS): readiness condition (3) / blocker B3 is satisfiable with a factory-provisionable credential-free local endpoint (the clearing candidate's GGUF + llama.cpp). The gated four-arm benchmark COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER (same model/tools/budget) becomes executable at that model class with the verified goal/schema prompt, subject to B1 (shipped carrier) and B2 (non-ceiling dynamic-range task bank), which are owned by Product and Runtime and are parallel to, not dependent on, B3. Whether C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL remains a DIRECTOR adjudication. The external-comparator readiness/reproducibility table bounds the fair comparator set for the benchmark.
product_consequence_negative: If no predeclared credential-free candidate CLEARS and no hosted provider is provisionable (OUTCOME=FALSIFIES, B3_STATUS=NOT_SATISFIED): the minimal multi-step Web-agent bar is not cleared by any credential-free Q4_K_M local class tested up to 14B and a non-Qwen 8B family, and the only reachable credential-free hosted path is operationally capped; readiness condition (3) is NOT_SATISFIED. The recorded exact blocker per hosted provider (missing credential environment variable or unreachable endpoint) and the census classification become decision inputs for the Global Research Director, who owns the re-scope choice: obtain a hosted credential (pinning/SLA), or drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor in favour of internally re-run comparators on a task bank with a dynamic-range certificate, or provision a different model class. This packet does not pre-decide the re-scope. A MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome changes no claim and requires the recorded repair before any re-run.
estimated_cost: CPU-only (nproc=4, 15 GB RAM, ~14 GB available, 85 GB free disk; design-time probe: Python 3.12.15, /usr/bin/google-chrome present; llama_cpp/playwright/openai NOT preinstalled -> EXECUTE installs). Downloads (design-time full-download verified, digest-pinned to served body): M-14B-QWEN 8,988,110,976 bytes + M-8B-LLAMA 4,920,739,232 bytes = ~13.9 GB worst case (early stop after the first clearing candidate may avoid the second download; the DESIGN-time full downloads used ~13.9 GB once). llama-cpp-python build (sdist) ~5-15 min. Inference: frozen runner runs 10 PC probes + up to 5 episodes x up to 5 steps per candidate; at the parent's measured 6.22 s/call for 7B (2.73 s/call for 3B), scaling to ~10-12 s/call for 14B gives ~5-15 min per candidate. Endpoint census <5 min. No external API spend (no credential exists; census is unauthenticated reachability only). Wall-clock estimate 60-180 min.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both directions, and strictly higher than a re-run of the invalid parent because the one blocking substrate defect is repaired and independently verified at DESIGN time. Positive: a credential-free capable class is found, B3 is cleared, and the flagship four-arm benchmark can proceed at that class. Negative: the credential-free Q4_K_M local path is bounded at the tested classes, the exact hosted-credential blocker is recorded per provider, B3 is explicitly NOT_SATISFIED, and the Director receives a concrete re-scope set plus a bounded external-comparator readiness/reproducibility table - so the four-arm benchmark is not funded on an unavailable anchor. It directly tests the parent handoff's declared unknown U-03 ('whether 14B+/non-Qwen GGUFs clear the bar') and the mandate's hosted-provisioning clause, and it does NOT re-run the spent 3B-8B prompt ablation or the spent Pollinations agent attempt. A third consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID is only possible if the served body drifts, in which case the recorded observed bytes/sha256/fingerprint is itself a durable substrate finding.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every branch is arithmetically reachable and no later rule is shadowed. SUPPORTS requires one COMPLETE candidate cell with task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6 (k>=3 of 5); the carried parent canary proved the same frozen scorer registers the full click-then-answer completion (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5, each episode revealing TARGET-42 and answering it) and the GBNF admits the success path (strchar ::= [^\"\\] admits '-', digits and uppercase, so \"selector\":\"#reveal-btn\" and \"text\":\"TARGET-42\" are grammar-admissible), so a clearing candidate can be registered; the candidates' true outcomes are empirically open, which is the point of the ladder. FALSIFIES is reachable whenever at least one candidate cell is COMPLETE and none clears; the carried anchor shows the parent realized exactly this failure mode at 3B-8B, and neither new candidate is guaranteed to clear. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure (rule 1) or no COMPLETE cell (rule 4). The threshold (0.6 over 5 episodes, k in 0..5, k>=3) is attainable at both ends; early stop at rule 3d cannot shadow FALSIFIES because when a candidate clears there is nothing left to falsify and when it does not the ladder continues; the corrected step-3a content-identity failure, a load failure, or a PC failure is explicitly non-terminal (continue), so the FALSIFIES/UNRESOLVED branch is not emptied by operational failure. The DESIGN-time full-download probe confirmed the frozen served_body_sha256 pins equal the actually served bytes, so the specific prior 3a dead branch is repaired.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is verified at DESIGN time or pinned fail-closed. (a) Stack (design-time probe): Python 3.12.15, nproc=4, 15 GB RAM / ~14 GB available, 85 GB free disk, /usr/bin/google-chrome present; curl/wget/git present; huggingface.co reachable (~127 MB/s). llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 has a PyPI sdist and no cp312 wheel (the parent built it from sdist); DESIGN downloaded that sdist and confirmed llama_chat_format.py registers BOTH 'llama-3' and 'qwen', so both candidates' chat_format load paths exist. playwright installs from PyPI without browser download when executable_path points at system Chrome. (b) Model provisioning (design-time FULL DOWNLOAD, not metadata): both candidate GGUFs were downloaded to completion from BOTH the revision-pinned URL and the main-ref URL and yielded byte-identical sha256 and byte counts (M-14B-QWEN 8,988,110,976 / e47ad95d...; M-8B-LLAMA 4,920,739,232 / 7b064f58...) equal to the HF tree-API lfs.oid and equal to the parent EXECUTE-observed served-body hashes; the parent's pinned xetHash/etag values are explicitly rejected as pins. baseline_identifiability.reason: The capability decision is against a pre-declared absolute bar (task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6), not against a within-run comparator, so there is no treatment/comparator identity problem. The measurement range is non-degenerate: the same frozen scorer registers 5/5 at the ceiling (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE) and the carried anchor produced 0/5 task success at the floor under the identical protocol, while the chance baseline is analytically confined below the bar (P(task_success_rate>=3/5)~1.15e-3). The manipulation across candidates is exactly the model weights (plus the family chat_format required to load them); task/prompt/grammar/sampling/parse/scorer are byte-inherited. The candidate content identity is now pinned to served-body sha256 + byte count + revision URL + GGUF header fingerprint, so a difference in task_success_rate is attributable to the model class and not to an unidentified artifact; any identity/load/PC failure is fail-closed and caught before the bar. The carried anchor is byte-identified and not re-run; its role is descriptive protocol-hardness certification, so a carried-anchor drift cannot silently become a comparator.

control_sensitivity.reason: All controls are sensitive and were executed at DESIGN/predecessor time as a non-outcome-bearing canary through the REAL frozen run_episode scorer with a REAL browser (Playwright + /usr/bin/google-chrome; name-only llama_cpp import stub; no model under test) against the served task page (prereg.md#appendix-b): PC-ORACLE-EPISODE fired 5/5 task_success (each episode revealed TARGET-42 and answered it, proving the completion path is registerable); NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION stayed 0/5 parseable and 0/5 success (rejects non-JSON); B-RANDOM-ACTION was parseable 1.0 and task_success_rate=0.2 with the 0.6 bar effectively unreachable by chance (analytic P(>=3/5)~1.15e-3). PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 was realized per model in the audited parent under the identical grammar and probe and is re-verified per candidate at EXECUTE. Distinct controls cover decoding, scoring, null rejection and chance-level success; none is tautological (none contains the target answer supplied to the model) and none is structurally impossible. A control failure yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a false capability result. This analysis is unchanged by the digest correction, which affects only the candidate provisioning step, not the controls.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment arm (a new candidate under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA + frozen GBNF, driven by the frozen runner) is structurally live and now provably provisionable: (a) the prompt enumerates exactly the two actions admitted by the frozen grammar using the grammar's required key names ('click' with 'selector', 'answer' with 'text'); (b) the success path is grammar-admissible (strchar admits '#reveal-btn' and 'TARGET-42'); (c) the same frozen scorer registered the full click-then-answer completion 5/5 in the canary; (d) the carried parent cells show this task family reliably emits parseable matched actions under constrained decoding (10/10 PC; 5/5 step-1 parseable); (e) BOTH candidate GGUFs were fully downloaded at DESIGN and their served-body sha256 equals the pin (so step 3a can pass), each is a well-formed GGUF v3 with the expected architecture/tensor count/file_type and an embedded tokenizer.chat_template, and llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 registers both 'qwen' and 'llama-3' chat formats. Self-attack (recorded, not hidden): (i) the frozen GBNF does not by itself guarantee matched action/field pairs, so liveness rests on empirically verified decoding behaviour plus the rule that a below-0.6 step-1 parseable rate can never clear the bar; (ii) the 14B GGUF (~9.0 GB) may fail to load on a 15 GB box - that candidate is then UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED and the ladder continues, and the 8B Llama (~4.9 GB) is comfortably loadable, so at least one candidate is measurable; (iii) a served-body drift between DESIGN and EXECUTE would fail step 3a - but DESIGN verified byte-identity across two routes now and against the parent's prior-day execute observation, and any drift is recorded with observed values. The P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA prompt leaks neither '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42' (design-time verified), so a positive is not an answer-leakage artifact.
